dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A toast... just for a nice day?

dialogues.speaker: Gorshkov
dialogues.text: Good weather means we won't see any massive storms out there. And no massive storms means these fishermen can return home safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Gorshkov
dialogues.text: Though most of them pride themselves on braving the waves, from the bottom of my heart, I wish they never had to face them at all.

dialogues.speaker: Gorshkov
dialogues.text: Parents get to welcome back their children, and children get to welcome back their parents... Now that is worth raising a glass to today.
